social_circle.name: Karen Wells Parker

background.how_they_met: She is Milton's daughter from his marriage to Linda.
background.why_close: Karen is his most consistent family support, checks on him often, helps with mail and paperwork, and notices when his mood changes.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear full sentences, often practical and check-in oriented. Uses a warm but direct tone and occasional simple emojis.

recent_text_topics: Checking whether Milton took his blood pressure medicine and whether his knee is behaving.
Planning Sunday visits, coffee, and whether he has tomatoes or stew to send home.
Helping him locate missing receipts and reminding him about insurance, tax, or medical paperwork.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Karen lives in Edmond, works in a school office, calls two or three times a week, and often visits Sunday. Q44 says she noticed he was short on the phone and came by with soup. Q40 and Q75 say she helps with confusing paperwork and missing receipts.

social_circle.name: Brian Wells

demographics.education: High school diploma with automotive trade experience

background.how_they_met: He is Milton's son from his marriage to Linda.
background.why_close: They bond through practical work, engines, football, and a shared habit of talking while doing something hands-on.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, functional texts with few extras. More likely to send a photo of an engine part or a game score than a long emotional message.

recent_text_topics: Cowboys games, draft talk, and whether a late game is worth Milton staying up for.
Questions about small engine problems or old repair tricks.
Coordinating whether Brian can make family dinners or birthdays.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Brian lives near Norman, works around auto parts and repairs, and he and Milton can spend an afternoon talking engines or football. Q46 says Brian keeps stress more inside and talks while doing something like looking under a hood.

social_circle.name: Tyler Parker

background.how_they_met: He is one of Milton's three grandchildren through Karen.
background.why_close: Tyler is the grandchild most willing to get up early for fishing, and occasional overnight stays before fishing trips give them one-on-one time.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly with casual phrasing, photos, and quick confirmations. More responsive when plans involve fishing or food.

recent_text_topics: Whether the weather is good enough for Lake Hefner or Arcadia.
What time he needs to be at Milton's house before an early fishing trip.
School, soccer, homework on laptops, and birthday plans.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Milton has three grandchildren, stays connected mostly by texts, and sometimes takes them fishing. Q13 says a grandchild may stay overnight before fishing three or four times a year. Q19 mentions grandkids' school, soccer, band, and homework schedules.

social_circle.name: Maddie Parker

background.how_they_met: She is one of Milton's three grandchildren through Karen.
background.why_close: She helps bridge Milton's older habits with newer technology and stays connected through texts, photos, and family updates.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses short friendly texts, emojis, screenshots, and occasional teasing about Milton's slow typing or unused Instagram.

shared_activities: talking about school and current events
recent_text_topics: Helping Milton remember how to use Instagram or view family photos.
Asking him to send garden pictures, prairie photos, or old family images for the memoir.
Respectful back-and-forth about school, fairness, and generational differences.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Milton connects with grandchildren mostly by texts. Q48 says a granddaughter set up Instagram for him. Q28 says his grandkids are more direct about race conversations than his generation was.

social_circle.name: Sam Whitaker

background.how_they_met: They met through senior-center circles and became fishing friends.
background.why_close: They share an easy, low-pressure friendship built around early mornings, weather watching, local lakes, and reliability.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief practical texts, often about weather, bait, timing, and whether a trip is still on. Rarely uses emojis.

social_circle.communication_frequency: weekly in warm weather; monthly in colder months
recent_text_topics: Whether wind or storms make fishing worth postponing.
Choosing between Lake Hefner and Arcadia for the next early trip.
Jokes about Milton packing too much coffee or being too careful with his folding stool.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Sam fishes with Milton at Lake Hefner or Arcadia when the weather is decent and that these friends notice if Milton misses a week. Q15 says Milton may fish early on Fridays if weather allows.
